interpretation.safe_result: The public performance route provides preliminary national all-grantee occurrence counts for bill-payment-related prevention and post-disconnection restoration.
not_established: health, food, medicine, housing, or work protection
trust, political action, switching, or exit
interpretation.counterinterpretation: Changes in occurrence counts can reflect need, funding, reporting, program rules, or data validation—not a causal change in household energy security. Prevention and restoration are program-reported occurrences and should not be treated as a single household-level success rate.

boundary: This is a reproducible aggregate performance extraction, not a person-level event ledger or causal trend estimate.
